paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次日常交谈前认出了熟悉的表情，也记得另一次没有留意面部细节。认得熟悉感、欣赏某一点与没有适合回忆可以并存，不必扩展为喜欢全部五官，也不从一个月里的时刻推断别人眼中的吸引力。例子只供阅读，不要求再照镜、找照片或复核细节。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls recognising a familiar expression before an ordinary conversation, while another occasion offers no memory of facial details. Familiarity, appreciating one detail and having no suitable recollection can coexist without liking every feature or inferring attractiveness to others from moments in a month. The scene is for reading, without another mirror look, photograph search or detail check.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈一个让我觉得熟悉的日常表情，不需要你评价好不好看。”可以只读虚构情境。听者不把欣赏某一点变成必须积极评价整张脸，也不把未评分当作否定外表；可以转到活动本身，或不继续讨论。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card discusses a familiar everyday expression without asking a listener to evaluate looks. Read only the fictional scene if preferred. A listener turns no appreciated detail into a duty to praise the whole face and treats no unscored response as a rejection of appearance. The conversation can turn to the activity or simply stop.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境和交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是研究量表的解释或改变外表的任务。16条仍按过去一个月的自报频率直接评分：1从不、2很少、3有时、4经常、5几乎每次；3不代替不确定，未评分不补零或3。四项各四条，至少三条数字才显示独立一位小数均值，例如2、3、5加一条未评分为3.3，两条则资料不足。均值不代表观察到的次数、适合机会的比例、外貌质量、别人评价、健康或人格。原题本尚无已建立的信效度、常模或中英文测量等值；不套用身体欣赏研究工具或颜值偏差值的权威。各项可以不同或相同，不合总分、选主导、分等级或作人群排名。无需上传、拍照、照镜检查、征求外貌确认、改变打理或购买。全部未评分仍可读四篇全文；可选标签页草稿的24小时期限、完成与重测清除保持原样，复制仅含公开标题和入口，不含答案、均值或个人标签。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not research-scale interpretations or appearance-change tasks. Sixteen prompts retain direct self-reported frequency over the past month: 1 never, 2 rarely, 3 sometimes, 4 often and 5 almost always. Three does not replace uncertainty, and unscored responses are imputed as neither zero nor three. Each of four parts needs at least three numeric ratings out of four for an independent one-decimal mean. For example, 2, 3 and 5 with one unscored response give 3.3; two ratings are insufficient. Means establish no observed count, proportion of suitable occasions, appearance quality, other person’s assessment, health or personality. The original form lacks established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese measurement equivalence, without borrowing authority from body-appreciation research instruments or hensachi attractiveness scales. Parts can differ or coincide without a total, dominant type, tier or population rank. No upload, photography, mirror checking, appearance reassurance, changed grooming or purchase is needed. All four full guides remain readable with every response unscored. Existing optional tab drafts retain their 24-hour expiry and completion or retake clearing. Copying includes only the public title and entry link, without answers, means or personal labels.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得某天自愿整理头发，另一日则没有调整任何细节。按自己选定的简单方式打理，与尝试新造型的频率可以不同；不把重复步骤当作更自律，也不把未发生的尝试当作欠缺。情境不说明任何产品有效，不要求复制行动、增加步骤或购买东西。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls voluntarily arranging their hair one day and making no adjustment on another. Following a chosen simple routine and trying a new style can have different frequencies. Repeated steps establish no greater discipline, and an absent experiment is no deficit. The scene establishes no product benefit and requires no copied action, extra step or purchase.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我愿意谈自己选择的一项日常安排，今天不需要打理建议。”可以只讨论虚构人物。听者不把步骤数量当作自我尊重，也不以均值推荐产品、花费或外表改变；不想说明安排时，可以略过而不解释原因。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card discusses one chosen everyday arrangement without requesting grooming advice. Discuss a fictional person only if preferred. A listener uses neither the number of steps as self-respect nor a mean to recommend products, spending or appearance changes. A routine may stay unexplained or be left out of the conversation.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得合照时仍听着朋友说话，之后选图却犹豫；另一次被拍时不太自在，选图后反而很快放下。拍摄与看图是不同环节，相同均值可能保留不同组合。例子不证明上镜程度，也不要求重拍、发布图片、练习表情或向别人确认照片是否准确。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls listening to a friend during a group photo but hesitating over the picture afterwards. On another occasion, taking the photo felt awkward but choosing it was quickly left behind. Taking and viewing are different stages that equal means can combine differently. The scene establishes no photogenic quality and requires no retake, public image, expression practice or confirmation of photographic accuracy.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“可以先说是否愿意参与合照，选图和公开图片另行决定。”不需要提供真实照片。听者不把参加活动当作同意拍摄或发布，也不要求给出好看的保证；可以只讨论共同活动，不解释个人均值或答案。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates choosing whether to join a group photo from later image selection and publication. No actual photo is needed. A listener treats activity participation as neither consent to photography nor permission to publish and offers no required reassurance about looks. Discuss only the shared activity without personal means or answers.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得熟悉任务中很投入，而初次见人时较留意外表；另一天，计划变化后也能继续听谈话。任务、熟悉程度与安排分别作为背景，不确定哪个因素解释了注意。例子不能推断他人看见的自信，也不要求重做场合、保持可见或证明自己足够自在。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls involvement in a familiar task but more appearance awareness when meeting someone new. On another day, conversation continued despite a changed plan. Task, familiarity and plans remain context without a known explanation of attention. The scene infers no confidence visible to others and requires no repeated encounter, continued visibility or proof of sufficient ease.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我更想谈那次活动里什么值得注意，外表细节可以不聊。”可以只围绕虚构情境。听者不把注意转移当作失败，不据均值要求更外向、留在现场或接受评价；也不向其他三项借答案解释原因，结束讨论始终可选。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card discusses what mattered in an activity while leaving appearance details aside. Use only the fictional scene if preferred. A listener treats no shift of attention as failure, demands no greater sociability, continued attendance or appearance evaluation from a mean and borrows no answers from the other three parts as a causal explanation. Ending the discussion remains an option.
